test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Beauty of it
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Good points.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Beauty of it"** refers to the good points or the positive aspects of something. (इसके सुंदर बिंदु)

 
 
• **Example: **The beauty of it is that you can work from anywhere in the world.
 
 
 
• **Good points** are the positive or advantageous aspects of a situation or thing. (अच्छे बिंदु)
 
 
• **Example: **The good points of this plan outweigh its drawbacks.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Good points**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Make things worse** (स्थिति को और खराब करना): To cause a situation to become more unpleasant or difficult.

 
 
• **Example:** Interfering now will only make things worse.
 
 
 
• **Cause for dispute** (विवाद का कारण): A reason or basis for disagreement or argument.
 
 
• **Example:** The ownership of the land was a major cause for dispute between the neighbors.
 
 
 
• **Quite ordinary** (काफी साधारण): Something that is very usual or normal, not special or unusual.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was quite ordinary and did not live up to the hype.

The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **fettered**.
